name: probe
js: (() => { const C = window.CITY; let n = 0, v = 0, raw = 0; for (const b of C.BLOCKS) { if (C.inCurbSmoothBox && C.inCurbSmoothBox(b.cx, b.cz)) { n++; v += b.poly.length; raw += C.GEO.blocks[b.id][0].length / 2; } } console.log('[curbs] islands in the box ' + n + ', outline points ' + raw + ' -> ' + v + ', smoothing ' + !!C.smoothCurbRing); const a = window.__CITY_APP; a.teleportTo(850, -3745, 0); a.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [850, 55, -3748], look: [850, 0, -3747], fov: 50 }); return 'ok'; })()
